name: news-1

card.headline: Local frog finishes one (1) task
card.sub: Celebrations expected to last the rest of the afternoon

caption:
Breaking news from the pond 🐸 The frog did one whole thing today and is now having a well-earned sit down. We're all very proud.

What was your one thing? (Getting dressed counts. It always counts.)

with love Sam

name: pond-1

card.text: The frog has made tea for Sid the snail. Sid said he'd be here at 3.

caption:
Sid did say 3. He didn't say which day. The tea is on its second refill and everyone is fine about it.

Meet the pond regulars this month: the frog, Sid the snail (always late, never sorry), Hermione the heron (a bit much) and Dot the dormouse (asleep since October).

name: fact-1

card.text: Frogs, toads and hedgehogs love a pile of leaves and logs. To them, your bonfire looks like a lovely bed.

caption:
If you're having a bonfire tonight, build it on the day if you can. If it's already built, move it bit by bit or have a good look through before you light it. The frog thanks you 🐸🔥

#FrogLogic #frogs

name: fact-2

card.text: Wood frogs freeze almost solid in winter. Their heart stops. In spring they thaw out and carry on.

caption:
They make their own antifreeze out of sugar, stay frozen all winter, and thaw out in spring, heart and brain first. Back to normal within about ten hours.

So if you're planning to go quiet until March, you're in excellent company 🐸❄️

name: fact-3

card.text: Glass frogs are see-through. When they nap, they tuck almost all their red blood cells away in their liver, so they're even harder to spot.

caption:
Scientists found they hide nearly 90% of their red blood cells while they sleep, then let them back out when they wake.

Even frogs need to go a bit invisible sometimes 🐸

name: fact-4

card.text: Some male common frogs spend all winter at the bottom of a pond, breathing through their skin.

caption:
Most of our frogs spend winter tucked under logs, rocks or compost heaps. A few stay down in the pond mud till spring.

Leave a pile of leaves in a corner of the garden and you've made someone a bedroom 🐸🍂
